name: Parmeshwar Metal Ltd
about: Incorporated in August 2016, Parmeshwar Metal Limited manufactures copper wire and rods by recycling copper scrap.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview[1]
Parmeshwar Metal Limited, ISO 9001:2015 certified, manufactures customized copper wires and rods from recycled scrap, catering to diverse industries.
Product Portfolio[2]
Copper Wire Rods: 8 MM, 12.5 MM, and 1.6 MM tailored to customer specifications.
Proposed Product: Bunched Copper Wire for enhanced flexibility and conductivity.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 24.0%
